newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam airline to bump up flights for Tet holiday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam airline to bump up flights for Tet holiday.

text.p: Vietnam Airlines will increase its domestic and international flight capacity by between 10 and 15 percent during next month's Tet lunar new year festival, an official at the state-owned flag carrier said on Tuesday.

He said there would be additional flights linking Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City and from Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok in the first week of February to accommodate a seasonal surge in demand from Vietnamese expatriates returning home.
The Saigon Times Daily said rail authorities in Ho Chi Minh City had also decided to run more trains during Tet after selling out of tickets for journeys between mid-January and February 5.
